definition.note: Doubly periodic embedded minimal surfaces parametrized by rectangular tori, from Karcher's 1988 Scherk-example constructions; the shape can be viewed as a doubly periodic version of Riemann's minimal surface.

provenance.definition: Derived from the Math Art generator registries and cross-referenced to the literature; not transcribed from any gallery's compilation.

description.summary: Karcher JE Saddle Tower is a doubly periodic minimal surface, given by a Weierstrass representation, immersed, with a layer group.
